extension.summary: Xtream Codes API client: live TV, EPG, catch-up, movies and series
extension.description: Browse channel groups and channels from an Xtream Codes compatible server, with now/next from a full XMLTV guide downloaded in the background, catch-up (timeshift) for channels with TV archive, movies (VOD) and series. The User-Agent is configurable and defaults to TiviMate's.
